cards.text: Every last piece of the tabernacle is done. Moses, Israel's leader, inspects all the work, sees it's just as the LORD commanded, and blesses the people (Exodus 39:43). Then the LORD speaks to Moses again.

cards.question: The tabernacle is built, but it's all still in pieces. When does the LORD say Moses should set it up?

answers.text: On the first day of the first month
On the seventh day of the seventh month
On the tenth day of the first month

cards.text: Then the LORD lays out where every piece will go: the ark of the Testimony behind the veil, the table, the lampstand, the gold altar of incense, the altar of burnt offering, the basin and the courtyard around it all. That's a LOT of assembly, friend, and I can't put together a cooling rack without THREE screws left over.
Next, Moses is to take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and everything in it. EVERYTHING, friend.

cards.question: Once Moses anoints the tabernacle and all its furnishings with the oil, the LORD says it shall be ___.
Moses is to anoint the altar of burnt offering and its utensils too. True or false: the LORD says that altar will be most holy.

cards.text: Moses is to anoint the basin and its stand too. That's the furniture, and now the LORD gets to the people: Aaron, Moses' brother, and his sons, brought to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

cards.question: At the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, the LORD tells Moses to wash Aaron and his sons with ___.
Moses is to clothe Aaron with the holy garments, anoint him and consecrate him. Why?

answers.text: So he may serve the LORD as a priest
So he may lead Israel into battle
So he may judge the people's disputes

cards.text: Then Aaron's sons are to come forward and get tunics. Moses is to anoint them just like he anointed their father, so they can serve the LORD as priests too.

cards.question: The anointing qualifies Aaron's sons for the priesthood. How long does the LORD say that priesthood will last?

cards.text: The LORD gave the orders, and now it's GO time. Moses does everything just as the LORD had commanded him.

cards.question: The tabernacle goes up on the first day of the first month of the ___ year.

cards.text: Then Moses sets it all up, piece by piece: the frames, the tent, the ark behind the veil, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the basin and the courtyard. He burns fragrant incense and offers the burnt offering and the grain offering, and Moses, Aaron and his sons wash their hands and feet at the basin. Over and over, it's just as the LORD had commanded him, and not ONE screw left over. So Moses finishes the work.

cards.question: The work is finished. Then what covers the Tent of Meeting?

cards.text: The cloud covers the Tent of Meeting, and the glory of the LORD fills the tabernacle. Take a breath right here, friend.

cards.question: True or false: Moses walks right into the Tent of Meeting while the cloud is settled on it.
From here on, whenever the cloud lifts from above the tabernacle, what do the Israelites do?

answers.text: They set out on their journey
They bring offerings to the altar
They gather to hear Moses speak

cards.text: And if the cloud doesn't lift, they don't set out until the day it does. No cloud moving, no people moving. Meanwhile I open the oven door every two minutes to ask the dough if it's done yet.

cards.question: By day, the cloud of the LORD is over the tabernacle. By night, there is ___ in the cloud.

cards.text: All the house of Israel can see the cloud and the fire, through all their journeys. Back when I was stuck in the dark at the back of a junk drawer, I'd have given anything for a light like that.
